cluster_results.evidence: Existing sealed evidence covers deterministic discovery, traceability, task compilation, prompt/context compilation, execution replay/resume and provenance, but the v1 MUST-01 representative end-to-end real-project lifecycle requirement is not yet proven as a complete claim.

No authoritative mutation matrix covering the full MUST-07 artifact universe was found in the sealed/current tree. Existing deterministic impact/provenance evidence is narrower than the v1 freshness requirement.

The frozen v0.10 transfer protocol and 3/3 separate-context trials provide exact narrow transfer/resume/reconstruction evidence, but do not by themselves establish every final v1 real-project transfer/rework claim.

Exact package identity, ownership/hash universes, clean restoration validation and active regression universe are preserved. The v1 MUST-11 threat-model/adversarial-security evidence is not established by those package-integrity results alone.

A substantial CLI and documentation surface exists, but candidate-exact end-to-end example reproduction, CLI/API contract verification and structured diagnostic evidence required by MUST-13/14 have not been reconciled to PASS.
v0.11.1 release lineage is reconciled, but MUST-15/16 are terminal v1-candidate gates and cannot pass before substantive v1 MUST gaps are closed and exact-state independent verification is run.

reason: Evidence reconciliation converts broad uncertainty into bounded objective gaps. MUST-07 freshness is the first dependency-relevant missing artifact and must be preregistered/frozen before implementation.
